metadata.title: Why a Dim Blue Lamp Beats a Blinding Red One
metadata.thing: light packets striking a metal, freeing an electron or not
metadata.color_notes: Colour carries the teaching: red packets #C0392B (low energy), blue packets #2A6FB0 (high energy) — a colorblind-safe pair. Metal block + electrons + text in ink #1a1a1a.

beats.narration_text: Blast a metal plate with the brightest red lamp you can find — not one electron escapes.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Blast a metal plate with the brightest red lamp you can find — not one electron escapes.
beats.new_visual_element: a person aiming a huge red floodlight at a metal plate, nothing happens

beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person aiming the huge lamp, the plate unchanged, the person looking puzzled]

beats.narration_text: Switch to a faint blue glow, and electrons fly off the instant it touches.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Switch to a faint blue glow, and electrons fly off the instant it touches.

beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person with the small light, little electron dots leaping off the plate, the person surprised]

beats.narration_text: Light doesn't arrive as a smooth stream; it comes in separate packets.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Light doesn't arrive as a smooth stream; it comes in separate packets.
beats.new_visual_element: a smooth beam breaking up into discrete flying packets
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: a smooth shaded beam from the left resolves into a row of separate small circular packets flying right

beats.narration_text: Each packet's energy is fixed by its colour — red packets weak, blue packets strong.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Each packet's energy is fixed by its colour — red packets weak, blue packets strong.
beats.new_visual_element: one small red packet and one large blue packet, with small/large energy marks
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: isolate a small red packet (low energy tick) beside a larger blue packet (tall energy tick); red #C0392B, blue #2A6FB0

beats.narration_text: Freeing an electron takes one packet landing enough energy in a single hit.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Freeing an electron takes one packet landing enough energy in a single hit.
beats.new_visual_element: a metal block holding electrons, with an escape-energy threshold marked above it
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a metal block on the right holding a row of electron dots; mark an 'escape energy' threshold line/bracket above the surface, ink

beats.narration_text: A red packet strikes, falls short, and bounces off — the electron stays put.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A red packet strikes, falls short, and bounces off — the electron stays put.
beats.new_visual_element: a red packet hits the surface, an electron jiggles but stays, the packet rebounds
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: a red packet flies in, strikes the surface, an electron wiggles in place, the red packet bounces back; threshold shows it fell short

beats.narration_text: Pile on millions of red packets and still nothing; weak hits never add up.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Pile on millions of red packets and still nothing; weak hits never add up.
beats.new_visual_element: a storm of red packets bombarding the surface; electrons all stay bound
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: a dense barrage of red packets pelts the surface and all rebound; electrons jiggle but none leave

beats.narration_text: One faint blue packet lands enough in a single blow — an electron flies free.
beats.tts_normalized_text: One faint blue packet lands enough in a single blow — an electron flies free.
beats.new_visual_element: a single blue packet strikes; one electron clears the threshold and shoots away
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: one blue packet flies in, strikes, an electron rises past the threshold and launches off the surface; blue #2A6FB0

beats.narration_text: Brightness only adds more packets; a packet's colour decides if it can free anything.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Brightness only adds more packets; a packet's colour decides if it can free anything.
beats.new_visual_element: a side-by-side tally: many red = 0 freed, one blue = 1 freed
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: a compact tally — a crowd of red packets with a '0 freed', beside a single blue packet with a '1 freed'

beats.narration_text: So light's energy comes in chunks, and one chunk's colour frees the electron.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So light's energy comes in chunks, and one chunk's colour frees the electron.
beats.new_visual_element: the freed electron with a single highlighted blue packet labelled the photon
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: highlight one blue packet (the photon) and the freed electron flying off; clean close
